evidence.detail: The class extends the already-reviewed ClientOverlay base and participates in the HIGH overlay render pass.
Its visibility predicate requires active interface id 59835 and the gambling-interface rule-switched boolean state rs/n/c/V.c.
The render hook draws the exact three-line message '@or2@The rules' / '@or2@have been' / '@or2@switched!' and the gambling-interface sprite rs/n/c/V.e.
The overlay uses rs/n/c/V.d with 500 ms / 1000 ms timing to animate/reset the same gambling notification state.
